summary: Iter 171 — 4 new Play Together features (leaderboard, invite-open+pending+remind, start-live-round -> trivia room, win-to-share card) regression on shared backend + web + mobile. BACKEND 11/11 pytest pass (test_iter171_play_features.py): (a) GET /api/social/play/referral-leaderboard -> items[] rank/user/referrals/points (=referrals*500), me{} with is_me flag; freeuser (not-in-top) correctly gets `me` payload. (b) POST /sessions/{sid}/opened logs the open; GET /sessions/{sid}/pending returns 403 for non-host and shows the opened-not-joined user for the host; POST /sessions/{sid}/remind creates a play_reminder social_notification, rate-limits to 0 within the same hour, and 403 for non-host. (c) POST /sessions/{sid}/start-round creates a BFM-XXXX trivia room, marks room_status=live on the play_session, is idempotent (returns same code on re-call), and 403 for non-host; GET /api/trivia/rooms/{code} returns phase='lobby' and the host in room.players. GET /api/social/play/sessions now surfaces room_code + room_live=true after start-round. (d) POST /api/social/share-card -> {card_id, image_url, share_url}; GET /share-card/img/{id} returns a real PNG (>15KB, magic bytes 89 50 4E 47) with content-type image/png (PUBLIC — no cookies needed); GET /share-card/{id} returns HTML with og:image / og:title / twitter:card meta tags. WEB (Chrome desktop 1280x900): logged in as demo -> /social -> social-do-play opens play-together-modal. (i) referral-leaderboard renders with rank 1 Demo Listener (5-6 refs, 2500-3000 pts), referral-rank-1 row present. (ii) play-create with title 'TEST_iter171 web start-round' created session ps_d0a67cd4153d48d6; 12 play-start-round-<sid> buttons rendered on host cards. (iii) Clicked play-start-round-* -> SPA navigated to /trivia/rooms/BFM-9HD5PG (Trivia room engine reused). After returning, the same session card shows a red 'LIVE' badge + 'Live round in progress — Join' CTA. (iv) 2 play-pending-<sid> panels visible with 2 play-remind-all-<sid> buttons (host with pending invites). (v) As freeuser: deep-link /social?action=play&session=<sid>&ref=<demoUid> auto-opened play-together-modal with a cyan play-invited-banner ('You're invited — join now'), leaderboard row 'You 0 pts' shown (referral-me path when not in top). SHOP TOGETHER regression: cart list renders + a cart opened without triggering 'Something went wrong' error boundary (the <Check> import fix from iter170 holds). MOBILE (Expo web preview, viewport 390x844): demo-login-btn -> tab-social -> social-do-play opened play-together-sheet. referral-leaderboard renders; 12 play-start-round-<sid>, 2 play-pending-<sid>, 2 play-remind-all-<sid>, 5 play-join-room-<sid> (live rooms) visible. Tapping play-start-round-* navigated to /trivia/rooms/BFM-K26PRS which rendered the lobby ('Just you for now', room code header, host chip, 'Start round' CTA) — Group Game Room integration works cleanly on mobile. No red screen errors on any tested surface. See minor observation about play-win-banner below (not blocking).

integration_issues.issue: OBSERVATION (not blocking): visiting /social?action=play&session=<new_sid>&ref=<hostUid> as an invited freeuser correctly auto-opens the play-together-modal AND shows the cyan play-invited-banner with a Join button — but the play-win-banner + play-share-win only render AFTER the invited user actually taps Join and the join response comes back with reward != null. In this run the win banner did not appear because the deep-link path stopped at 'opened' + invited-banner and did not auto-invoke join. Iter170 reported the same URL auto-joined the invited user; this may be a soft regression where the auto-join step is now gated behind an explicit Join tap, or the run's freeuser had already been marked joined and the reward-side branch skipped. Backend join flow itself is verified fine (reward:500 returned in the pytest join-after-opened test). Suggest main agent confirm intended UX for deep-link auto-join vs explicit Join tap.

action_items: OPTIONAL: confirm the intended UX for the /social?action=play&session=<sid>&ref=<uid> deep-link — should the invited freeuser auto-join (immediately awarding +500 + showing play-win-banner) as iter170 documented, or now surface the invited-banner + explicit Join tap first? Both flows work end-to-end from the API; only the UI trigger for play-win-banner differs.

OPTIONAL: no other blockers. All 4 new Play Together features (leaderboard, opened/pending/remind, start-live-round -> trivia lobby navigation, win-to-share card PNG+OG) are fully wired and verified on shared backend + web + mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: start-round host guard (routes/social_together.py:736) correctly 403s non-hosts and idempotently reuses an existing live room via `hub.get(p['room_code'])` — no duplicate room creation on double-tap. Also stamps room_status='live' + room_started_at, which the list endpoint exposes as room_live=true (line 454) so the UI can pop the 'Live round in progress — Join' CTA without a second round-trip.
share-card image + OG-page endpoints are UNAUTHENTICATED by design (needed for FB/IG scrapers) — verified they return 200 without any cookie. Good separation.

Rate-limit for remind (routes/social_together.py:706-711) queries social_notifications for a 1-hour window per (session_id, user_id) — clean, no separate table needed. Verified: 2nd call within seconds returns reminded=0 while eligible stays intact.
share_cards.py render_win_card_png (line 39) draws a proper 1200x630 OG PNG with gradient + Liberation fonts already installed in the container. PNG magic bytes and size (>15KB) confirmed in test.
Test file: fixed one initial assertion (trivia GET returns {room:{phase:'lobby',...}} wrapper, not phase at top level) — all 11 tests now green.
